title: GameTranslation workspace metadata
description: Metadata for one per-game workspace under the system temp workspace root. Private data (glossary/tone/notes) lives beside this file but is NEVER committed to the repo.

schema_version.description: Bump when a field changes meaning. Readers must refuse unknown versions.

engine.description: Detected engine family (not a game name).

source.description: Fingerprint of the ORIGINAL game directory. Never the workspace path.

fingerprint.description: Stable hash/identity of the source used to detect staleness.

path_hint.description: Masked or relative hint only. Do NOT store a real machine path.

status.description: delivered/abandoned workspaces may be cleaned; the rest are protected.

delivered.description: True once a build was delivered; workspace clean keeps it.

exported.description: True once per-game dictionaries were exported outside the workspace.

translation_language.description: Target language tag for the translation, e.g. zh-Hans.
